answer_1.quote: we propose MOVER (Mask, OVEr-generate and Rank), an unsupervised approach to generating hyperbolic paraphrase from literal input.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation BLEU reflects the lexical overlap between the generated and the ground-truth text. BERTScore computes the similarity using contextual embeddings. ... We report the BLEU and BERTScore metrics for generated sentences compared against human written hyperboles.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation ... We evaluate the generation results from the 71 testing literal sentences. Each pair of texts (ours vs. a baseline / human reference) is given preference (win, lose or tie) by five people with proficiency in English. We use a set of four criteria adapted from [citation] to evaluate the generated outputs: 1) Fluency (Flu.): Which sentence is more fluent and grammatical? 2) Hyperbolicity (Hypo.): Which sentence is more hyperbolic? 3) Creativity (Crea.): Which sentence is more creative? 4) Relevance (Rel.): Which sentence is more relevant to the input literal sentence?
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare pairs of texts and indicate preference based on four criteria.
